name: one_slide_framework
title: One-slide framework
description: A single framework slide (2x2 matrix, pyramid, cycle, process, layered stack or canvas grid), optionally with a cover, an explanation and an example.
storyline: The framework carries the message: label every box with a short noun phrase and one line of explanation; the title says what the framework shows.

framework.guidance: Four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) with x_axis and y_axis labels; optional points with x, y in 0..1.
3-5 levels, top first, each with a one-line description.
3-8 stages in order; optional centre label.
3-6 steps, each a verb phrase with one line of detail.
Layers from top to bottom, each with a one-line role.
Cells with row/col/rowspan/colspan for a canvas; a title and 1-3 bullets per cell.

slots.title: <What the framework shows, as a sentence>
<How to use it>
slots.guidance: How to read and apply the framework, 3-4 points.

slots.title: <The framework applied to a case>
slots.guidance: Left: the case; right: where it lands and what follows.
